data.answer: Skippi is a food and beverage company specializing in premium ice pops, crunchy corn sticks, and delicious sweet cream rolls. The company is expanding its business in the FMCG sector, adding new categories to its product line such as snack & bakery items along with ice pops. Skippi Ice Pops are available pan India and can be found on online platforms like Amazon, Flipkart, Zepto, Jio Mart, Blink It, and Swiggy Insta-Mart. The major ingredients in Skippi Ice Pops are natural flavors, RO water, and natural sweeteners, with no artificial preservatives, colors, or sweeteners. Skippi Ice Pops are suitable for all ages and are available in flavors like cola, mango twist, orange, raspberry, and Kala Khatta. Skippi Ice Pops do not require refrigeration and can be frozen at home.

The founders aim to make Skippi a global FMCG brand from India. Some goals include: [...] ## What is Skippi Ice Pops?

Founded by Ravi Kabra and Anuja Kabra, Skippi Ice Pops is India’s first brand offering naturally flavored, 100% hygienic, and preservative-free ice pops. Remember the colorful sticks we used to call “pepsi” in childhood? Skippi revived this nostalgic treat—only better, safer, and more premium.

Key features of Skippi Ice Pops:

 Made from natural flavors
 No artificial sweeteners or colors
 Available in exciting flavors like raspberry, mango twist, cola, and orange
 No refrigeration required—just freeze at home

This innovation made the product attractive for kids, health-conscious parents, and even retailers in hot regions.
